subject.title: feat: add metadata-only message audit events

question: Should OpenClaw permanently support the proposed opt-in `audit.messages` configuration, persistent pseudonymous message identities, and versioned message lifecycle query contract once the upgrade defect is repaired?
rationale: This creates long-lived privacy, storage, configuration, and public protocol commitments under a protected maintainer item; implementation correctness alone cannot establish product sponsorship.

options.title: Sponsor after repair
options.body: Approve the core feature after automatic upgrade migration, exact-head conflict resolution, and real runtime proof are complete.

options.title: Narrow the contract
options.body: Reduce the retained fields, event families, or public query surface before accepting the long-term core contract.

options.title: Defer the capability
options.body: Pause the PR if maintainers do not want core to own durable message lifecycle metadata.

recommendation.title: Sponsor after repair
recommendation.body: Approve the core feature after automatic upgrade migration, exact-head conflict resolution, and real runtime proof are complete.

likelyOwner.reason: The existing audit contract, canonical feature issue, and proposed implementation most directly trace to this owner.
